description: Split a column into multiple columns by a delimiter. Use when you need to divide a single column into multiple columns based on a specific delimiter. Do NOT use when you need to convert data types or clean data; use convert_table or clean_table instead.
name: split_column

data.description: The modified data string with the column split into new columns.

errors.description: An array of error messages, if any, encountered during the split operation.

new_columns.description: An array of new column names created from the split operation.

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating whether it was successful or if there were any errors.

title: Split column
